Game Overview

In AstroJump, the core idea is straightforward: leap into the cosmos with AstroJump, where you defy gravity and dodge menacing space monsters with every bound. Stay sharp and nimble as your astronaut ventures ever upward. Will you conquer the stars or fall to cosmic creatures? Reach new heights in this thrilling celestial escape.
